summary.text: Roy Cooper is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 40, where he has served since 2012, and is seeking re-election against Democrat Jennifer Gilkerson in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Navy veteran, he has worked as a farmer and school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Roy Cooper was born in Warford, West Virginia, and served in the U.S. Navy.

He earned an associate degree in business management from Tidewater Community College and a B.S. in education from Concord College, and his career experience includes working as a farmer and school teacher.
Cooper has volunteered as a member of the National Rifle Association and the American Federation of Teachers.

In the 2023-2024 session Cooper chaired the Veterans Affairs and Homeland Security Committee and also served on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Energy and Manufacturing, and Health and Human Resources Accountability committees.
